message: Conservative identity standardization leaves the development error gap unchanged.
caption: The same 3,344 development compounds: RDKit Cleanup plus charge-retaining FragmentParent changed zero fold assignments after alignment. Historical and standardized nested raw MAE agree to numerical precision (ridge differs by less than 3e-15); lower is better. This is a split-identity control, not a change to prepared Nesso molecular states. The separate all-790 validation refit is not plotted.
design: Two paired flat trajectories directly show exact reproduced errors and the retained descriptor gap without overlapping before/after symbols or implied equivalence testing.
